line: A printed octilinear map of Guangzhou's real metro is dragged out line by line from five stations under the Pearl River in 1997, trains running on every finished line, until Line 11 closes the ring and the counter lands on 19 lines and 779.9 km.
line_cn: 一张印出来的八方向广州地铁图：从 1997 年白鹅潭江底的 5 个站开始，一条条线被拖出来，开通的线上一直有车在跑；11 号线把环合上，计数器落在 19 条线、779.9 公里。
uses: A metro or rail network's growth, year by year
One new line, a ring or an extension, drawn stop by stop
A network shown alive: lines, interchanges and trains on one printed map
